text:
To resolve permission issues when running Hermes Agent in Docker on a NAS (including UGOS, Synology, or unRAID), you need to remap the container's user and group permissions.

Pass the **`PUID`** and **`PGID`** (or **`HERMES_UID`** / **`HERMES_GID`**) environment variables when running your container to match your host user's UID and GID:

```bash
docker run -it \
  -e PUID=$(id -u) \
  -e PGID=$(id -g) \
  -v /path/to/host/data:/opt/data \
  nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest
```
*(Alternatively, use `-e HERMES_UID=$(id -u) -e HERMES_GID=$(id -g)`)*
